title: Anti-inflammatory effects of Rehmannia glutinosa polysaccharide on LPS-induced acute liver injury in mice and related underlying mechanisms.
authors: Qiao, Hanzhen; Ren, Heng; Liu, Qingyu; Jiang, Yue; Wang, Qingyuan; Zhang, Huadong; Gan, Liping; Wang, Peng; Cui, Yaoming; Wang, Jinrong; Chou, Yixuan; Chen, Luyao; Shi, Jiaxin; Dou, Yule
one_liner_zh: 该文研究地黄多糖对LPS诱导肝损伤的抗炎作用，虽含分子对接与动态模拟，但对象为多糖-TLR4蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法聚焦于TF-DNA结合，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Rehmannia glutinosa (Gaertn.) DC., a perennial herb, has a rich cultivation history of over a thousand years across numerous Asian countries. This highly valued crop finds utility in both industrial and medicinal applications, providing promising clinical outcomes in enhancing immunity and mitigating inflammation in the body. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate the protective effects of RGP against liver injury in mice and identify the underlying mechanisms. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A mouse model of liver injury was established by treating mice with administered varying concentrations of RGP (50-200 mg/kg) for 14 days before the intraperitoneal administration of 5 mg/kg LPS. Additionally, a RAW264.7 macrophage cell injury model was established using LPS treatment. Comprehensive methodologies, including flow cytometry, Western blot, ELISA, and RT-PCR, were employed in combination with molecular docking and dynamic simulation techniques to simulate and examine the binding interactions between RGP and cell membrane proteins. The goal of this multifaceted approach was to gain deeper insights into the anti-inflammatory mechanisms of RGP against liver injury. RESULTS: In cell-based experiments, RGP demonstrated the ability to reduce intracellular ROS levels, inhibit cell apoptosis, and decrease intracellular NO levels as well as iNOS mRNA expression. Furthermore, by modulating the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway, RGP could decrease the mRNA expression and serum levels of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6. Animal experiments further revealed that RGP could reduce MDA and CAT contents, improve the redox balance, and regulate the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling axis in mice. After RGP treatment, the gene and protein expression levels of pro-inflammatory factors such as TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, IL-6, and caspase-1 were reduced in vivo, while the gene expression levels of the anti-inflammatory factor IL-10 were upregulated. Molecular docking and dynamic simulation analyses indicated that RGP could tightly bind to the TLR4 membrane protein and exert anti-inflammatory effects by directly regulating the TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB signaling axis. CONCLUSIONS: These findings provide a theoretical foundation for the development of effective clinical agents that attenuate acute liver injury and enable its treatment.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：地黄（Rehmannia glutinosa (Gaertn.) DC.）是一种多年生草本植物，在众多亚洲国家拥有超过千年的丰富栽培历史。这种高价值作物在工业和医药应用中均具有用途，在增强免疫力和缓解体内炎症方面展现出良好的临床效果。研究目的：探讨RGP对小鼠肝损伤的保护作用，并明确其潜在机制。材料与方法：通过给小鼠灌胃不同浓度的RGP（50-200 mg/kg）14天，然后腹腔注射5 mg/kg LPS，建立小鼠肝损伤模型。此外，利用LPS处理建立RAW264.7巨噬细胞损伤模型。采用流式细胞术、Western blot、ELISA和RT-PCR等综合方法，结合分子对接和动态模拟技术，模拟并检测RGP与细胞膜蛋白之间的结合相互作用。这一多层面方法的目标是深入理解RGP抗肝损伤的抗炎机制。结果：在细胞实验中，RGP显示出降低细胞内ROS水平、抑制细胞凋亡、减少细胞内NO水平及iNOS mRNA表达的能力。此外，通过调节TLR4/NF-kappaB信号通路，RGP可降低促炎细胞因子（包括TNF-alpha、IL-1beta和IL-6）的mRNA表达和血清水平。动物实验进一步揭示，RGP可降低MDA和CAT含量，改善氧化还原平衡，并调节小鼠体内的TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号轴。经RGP处理后，体内促炎因子（如TNF-alpha、IL-1beta、IL-6和caspase-1）的基因和蛋白表达水平降低，而抗炎因子IL-10的基因表达水平上调。分子对接和动态模拟分析表明，RGP能紧密结合TLR4膜蛋白，并通过直接调节TLR4/MyD88/NF-kappaB信号轴发挥抗炎作用。结论：这些发现为开发有效缓解急性肝损伤并实现其治疗的临床药物提供了理论基础。
